description: A slide-in panel built on Radix UI Dialog. Behaves identically to a modal dialog for accessibility purposes — focus is trapped, Escape closes, and aria-modal is set. The side prop (top, right, bottom, left) controls visual positioning but has no effect on accessibility semantics.

keyboard.action: Cycles focus through focusable elements inside the sheet
Cycles focus backwards through the sheet

focus.notes: Focus is automatically moved to the first focusable element when the sheet opens. On close, focus returns to the trigger element. Focus is trapped — Tab/Shift+Tab cycle within the sheet boundary.

announcements: Sheet title is announced via aria-labelledby
Sheet description is announced via aria-describedby
The sheet is announced as a modal dialog (aria-modal="true")
screenReader.notes: The overlay prevents interaction with elements behind the sheet. Screen readers will not navigate outside the sheet while it is open.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — sheet uses card-foreground on card background

motion.reducedMotion: Slide and fade animations respect prefers-reduced-motion

consumerResponsibilities: Always include a SheetTitle for screen reader context
Include SheetDescription for additional context when needed
Ensure the trigger element clearly indicates it opens a sheet
The side prop is purely visual — do not rely on it for accessibility cues
